checks.requirement: Reviewed profiles, protected durable intent and recovery before desired publication
Reproducible pinned roles and wrong database, site, inventory and release refusal
Count-only resizing, persistent selected drain and partial-start reconciliation
Unavailable readiness on connection loss and recovery after reconnection
Graceful active drain, bounded forced interruption, generation reclaim and stale claim refusal
Maintenance refusal before reserve, resize/upgrade exclusion in both directions and new release profile adoption
Connection and resource observation, host regressions and owned Docker retirement

host_regression.skip: Existing Windows source/data symlink case; unchanged startup code retains prior Linux qualification

qualification_boundary: Disposable single-site Docker roles on the same reviewed application image. The idle memory and connection samples are observations, not sustained capacity limits. No autoscaler, multi-host execution, higher workspace concurrency or remote provider is qualified here. Those remain separate follow-up decisions and drills.
